interface.signature: int N, int P, List[List[int]] prerequisites -> bool

preconditions.description: The number of tasks N must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of prerequisite pairs P must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < N and 0 <= y < N for x, y in prerequisites)
preconditions.description: All prerequisite pairs must refer to valid task indices within the range [0, N-1].

postconditions.expression: return_value == (len(prerequisites) == len(set(tuple(p) for p in prerequisites)))
postconditions.description: The function returns true if there are no duplicate prerequisite pairs.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (not any(x == y for x, y in prerequisites))
postconditions.description: The function returns true if no task has a direct prerequisite on itself.
The function returns true if the number of prerequisite pairs does not exceed the maximum possible pairs for N tasks.
